viva_insights.collinearity_handling: High collinearity (e.g. sbytes <-> sloss at r=0.9961, tcprtt <-> synack at r=0.9495) reflects physical network protocol mechanics (lost packets scale with sent volume; round-trip time consists of SYN-ACK and ACK-DATA latencies). Rather than blindly discarding these features, tree-based models (Random Forest, XGBoost) natively isolate threshold splits without variance inflation, while L2 regularization controls coefficients in Logistic Regression.
viva_insights.benchmark_split_preservation: The official train/test partition created by Moustafa & Slay is strictly maintained. Randomly recombining would cause test-set leakage across synthetic and real captures and violate academic reproducibility.
viva_insights.extreme_minority_attacks: Worms (130 train / 44 test) and Shellcode (1,133 train / 378 test) represent severe class imbalance, requiring balanced class weighting and macro-F1 evaluation.
